notes.title: Demo Update: The Mines Update
notes.notes:
Play the updated Upheaval demo now!



Navigate the twisting passages of the abandoned mines, discover the secrets buried deep within, and beware the nameless terror that stalks below ground. In addition, you can now join the goblins by appealing directly to the Goblin King himself, if you're so inclined.


Highlights from this update


New region: The Mines! Twisting passages, magical fungi, rusty lanterns, buried secrets, a nameless terror and more!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/a2d0569f23c376cfc6134f7d3b94c64325ae497c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/40f0f93ab061c1eabca425a3cc028905b36163b0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/ab40dbfb178eb4735e5327aa9980585edf889e8f.png"]

Join the goblins, if that sort of thing appeals to you! The Goblin King will take your petitions now.

Special Thanks

Big thank you to Jay, Olivia, Undrhil, Xvordan, and Lundis for playtesting this release! I couldn't do this without my playtesters! Thank you so much for all your help!

Read the full changelog on itch.io.


Play it Now

Try out these changes, start a new adventure! 🥳

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253300/Upheaval/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Small Bugfixes
notes.notes:
A few players reported some out of memory errors and issues with the text-to-speech. This minor update should fix both of them!

Changes for version 0.0.23:


 Fixed occasional out of memory errors on certain devices.
 Fixed text-to-speech issue on the main menu.


Thank you! ❤️

notes.title: Demo Update: The Good Manners Update
notes.notes:
Play the updated Upheaval demo now!

Explore whole new rooms and locations, talk to two new NPCs (parent and child, both nobility), and discover the secrets of the manor, either by earning the trust of the lord or lady of the house, or by poking around until you're kicked out. In addition, there are new graphics that help convey the passage of time more clearly.

Highlights from this update

New region: The Manor! New rooms to explore, books to read, archives to visit, dinner to eat. Enjoy all the luxuries that nobility affords!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/9189254fe48f3917d4d1c00a0ea1cd9d31a051c4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/5ded4281ff2f713dd11a725fd5e210d0d91ba524.png

Two new characters: The Noble and the Lover (the Noble's son or daughter). Get to know both, improve your relationship with one or both (or neither), and explore all the interactions with these characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/a35e779d2ad5da74ad3f9423cef975ed6e023105.png

Discover all the secrets in the Manor! Hidden passages, old knowledge, and lost paintings. Can you discover all the secrets of the Manor?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/4d1ae0c67c48c4f30450e99ef8dced417e060d99.png

The Lover in the Manor and the Prisoner in the Cave are determined to marry each other. Will they remain separated, or will true love prevail?

Special Thanks

Big thank you to Chad, Carlos, Andrew, and Lundis for playtesting this release! I couldn't do this without my playtesters! Thank you so much for all your help!

Read the full changelog on itch.io.

Play it Now

Try out these changes, start a new adventure! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253300/Upheaval/

notes.title: Demo Update: The Kitfox Update
notes.notes:
Play the updated Upheaval demo now!

In this update, you can meet an adorably curious kitfox, an aggressive billy goat, and an elusive squirrel! There are also new mapping features, fixed bugs, a new verbosity setting for text-to-speech, and improved signposting throughout the game. I hope you enjoy! 🥳

Highlights from this update

Meet the kitfox! It runs around the map, playing with you and sniffing at the ground. What’s it looking for?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/e2fea032bbc650476a066264689fec70ac1a934c.png

Meet the billy goat! It leaps about on the mountain, looking for something to fight. Will that be you today?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/c61c91d9206c77f21a344ba25a729c142498968c.png

New helpful navigation path on the overworld map! Right-click or long-press the map, and a path will appear on the map showing you how to get there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/ac1ecf655b0cd210a0784ec3ad3c3e285bd8c1c4.png

A mysterious ruby-eyed squirrel, a character from a very early prototype, finally back in the game. Where will you find it?

Special Thanks

Big thank you to Kurt and Chad for playtesting this release! I couldn't do this without my playtesters! Thank you so much for all your help!

Read the full changelog on itch.io.

Play it Now

Try out these changes, start a new adventure! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253300/Upheaval/

notes.title: Critical Bugfix
notes.notes:
Full changelog for version 0.0.20:

 Fixed game crashing on load for new players! 😩

notes.title: The Wild Badger Update
notes.notes:
This one is a minor update mainly to fix some issues with text-to-speech on Mac and Linux, and also to address some feedback I got about text-to-speech generally. But I also added a wild badger to the game that I’m happy about, and that makes for a cooler update name, so this is the Wild Badger Update!

Special thanks to Michael Taboada in the itch.io comments who helped me fix text-to-speech on Mac and Linux, and all the feedback and suggestions I got from the AudioGames forums and the Discord! 🙏

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/af83580572e802fbb3ea00184a3106ef7a2bf209.png

Enjoy. 😊

Full list of changes for version 0.0.19:


 Added a wild badger to a random location in the region south of town! You have to search to find it.
 Fixed text-to-speech not working for many players on Mac or Linux.
 Added new in-game information to text-to-speech options that should make it easier to integrate your screen reader.
 Fixed some minor issues with input focus.
 Added mailing list button to main menu.
 Added better crash reports so I can fix more bugs. 😄


Thank you! ❤️

notes.title: Minor Update #3
notes.notes:
Several users on the AudioGames forum requested a text-to-speech feature that turned out to be pretty easy to implement, so I added it, and Michael Taboada reported a Linux issue in the comments on itch.io that has been fixed now. So here's a tiny update with those! Enjoy. 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/de8802f9be9bf930b28a94bbbd47f589d32031a1.png

Full list of changes for version 0.0.18:

 Added "Copy Speech to Clipboard" setting for Windows only. This allows players to use some screen readers (such as NVDA) with the graphical version of Upheaval. See the accessibility page for more information.
 Fixed issue on Linux that was causing the game to ask for elevated privileges. 😱

Thank you! ❤️

notes.title: Demo Update: Text-to-Speech, Keyboard, and Controller Support
notes.notes:
Play the updated Upheaval demo now!

In this update, you can play Upheaval using text-to-speech, use keyboard or controller input, and pursue any of the adventure hooks in the new random village events.

Read about all the new and old accessibility features here.

Highlights from this update

Text-to-speech available in all graphical versions! To activate text-to-speech, use these shortcuts:


 Keyboard: Shift + T
Controller: Left stick button + Right stick button (together)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/7bdcf991bc58258575c2349bb46dce8218ed7e45.png

Full keyboard and controller support! Read about the default controls here. Controls will be made configurable in a future update, sometime before full release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/99a31285c5574da169ee1fb972e49e00e9fceca0.png

New random events in town! Each event will tell you about a new adventure you can go on, either short or long. Hopefully these provide fun options for players unsure of what to do next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/7bdcf991bc58258575c2349bb46dce8218ed7e45.png

Special Thanks

Big thank you to Chad, Tuan, and Aziz for playtesting this release, and to Xvordan for all the bugs they reported that got fixed in this update! 🪳🔨

Read the full changelog on itch.io.

Demo Available

If you want to try out these changes, play the demo on Steam right now! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253300/Upheaval/

notes.title: Goblin Key Bugfix
notes.notes:
A few players reported sometimes getting stuck in the goblin caves with no way out. 😱 This update fixes the issue they were running into!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/685e2c87bc0b72d4941f7ce90d8a5fa916aff9f7.png

Changes for version 0.0.16:


 Now, if the game says you STOLE a goblin key, you will always HAVE a goblin key in your inventory, no matter what.


Thank you! ❤️

notes.title: Minor Update #2
notes.notes:
A few small changes from the previous release, including a bug fix pointed out by PHOBIE on the Steam discussion forum, thank you!

Full list of changes for version 0.0.15:


 Fixed ranger sometimes seeing you even when you're invisible.
 Made the tutorial mention that the locations of treasures change from game to game starting the first time you play, instead of waiting until the second time, so that you know better what to pay attention to in your first playthrough.
 Made hermit give you more useful information about the mysterious box when you haven't discovered its secret yet.
 Graphical version: Fixed how the "You came from this direction" tooltip acts in the secret tunnel.


Thank you! ❤️

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
A few small changes from the previous release, including a bug fix pointed out by Shane and Dalen Lewin on the AudioGames.net forum, thank you!

Full list of changes for version 0.0.14:


 Fixed option to give your dagger to the bandits always showing when you try to join them, even when you don't have the dagger.
 Added ability to give your magic map to the bandits.
 Added new clues or hints for getting through each locked door.


Thank you! ❤️

notes.title: Demo Update: New Beginnings
notes.notes:
Play the updated Upheaval demo now!

In this update, you can play Upheaval's brand-new opening sequence, track your meta-progress, make use of an improved map, and enjoy an expanded tutorial.

Highlights from this update

Brand-new beginning to the game! Receive a mysterious letter, choose a starting item, and learn more about the town, yourself, and your surroundings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/7bdcf991bc58258575c2349bb46dce8218ed7e45.png

New map features! Labels for regions, labels for people (Magic Map only), and an optional node map overlay for players who want to know precise locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/99a31285c5574da169ee1fb972e49e00e9fceca0.png

Track meta-progress across all your adventures. Unlock the Magician's Diary and review records of your adventures after your first completed run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/ae59a71eee1f364910466c68bb89a742f396fac0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/6b32b7d4d33aff2ef43d524e02f9976d2b2d498d.png

Expanded tutorial from the tavernkeeper that optionally teaches some of the finer mechanics of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43369263/644ae4c657f820effa08e94e478132438e875994.png

Community Suggestions

These next additions came from the Steam Community discussions. Thanks so much to Phobie for suggesting or workshopping all of these!


 Magician's Diary and Records: Keep track of your meta-progress over the course of your adventures.
 Added indicators so you can tell which options are affected by randomness (graphical version: 🎲, command line version: success/failure is random).
 Added tooltip to “Search this area” that shows how many times you searched it before you click search.
 Graphical version: Added tooltip that shows which option leads back to the place you just came from.
 Graphical version: Added labels to the map (can be disabled in Settings, on by default).
 Graphical version: Added node map overlay to the map (can be enabled in Settings, off by default).


Read the full changelog on itch.io.

Demo Available

If you want to try out these changes, play the demo on Steam right now! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253300/Upheaval/

notes.title: Music and Sounds Update out now! Alpha version 0.0.9
notes.notes:
Upheaval just got ambient background sounds for all 57 locations! Plus new background music by Alexander Nakarada, and a main menu theme by developer Alex Leone (that's me). Not only that, but the tavernkeeper got a major overhaul, you can now see how much of an area you've already searched, the overlook and tower lookout areas have been made functional (i.e. you can actually see far-off people and places from up there), AND the new and helpful manor archives tour has been added in town! Lots of new stuff in this update. 🙂

All new content has been added to the demo. You can try the updated free demo now!

You can get the full alpha update on itch.io or Google Play.

notes.title: Upheaval Graphical Update! New Graphics and Cover Art
notes.notes:
I'm pretty excited about this! 😄 The new cover art for Upheaval and the graphical update to the game itself are part of Alpha Version 0.0.7, which you can get on itch.io or Google Play. Try the free demo today!

Highlights


 New background images and lots of graphical improvements! 😄
 New character/inventory screen! Keep track of your current goal and any statuses that are affecting you, such as Tired, Cursed, Enchanted, or Drunk. (Thanks to Ran S.!).
 Dark mode! One of the most highly requested features. Save your eyes when you play at night! (Thanks to Andrew and Ran S.!)
 Added keyboard shortcuts for many actions on the Windows version (see what they all are in the full changelog).
